Because of Dorin's orientation between two nearby black holes, we'll need your expert space combat tactics to help guide the command ships and fighter squadrons.|Plo Koon, to Anakin Skywalker|}} The '''Battle of Dorin''' took place at the start of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] struck at the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] in retribution for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] loyalty to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Separatist invasion also served as a diversion to prevent the Republic from assaulting the Confederacy's [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|new droid foundry]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], which the Republic had [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|recently discovered]]. Although the Kel Dors suffered in the defense of their planet and initially began to be overwhelmed by Grievous's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]], a large Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived to reinforce Dorin. In the subsequent [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Space warfare/Legends|engagement]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were able to turn the tide against the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist assault fleet]], forcing a Confederate retreat from Dorin. While his remaining forces were routed by the Republic, Grievous managed to escape from the battle in his [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Tactical coordinates for Count Dooku's new droid foundry. And Clovis and the Banking Clan are behind it. The Jedi Council has to see this evidence.|Padmé Amidala discovers the existence of the foundry|audio=DroidFoundryEvidence-SS.flac|{{TCW|Senate Spy}}}} [[File:Pogglefactory-WF.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] conspires in the main droid foundry on Geonosis.]] At the start of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built a series of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] foundries on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the site of the war's [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]],{{Film|II}} to expand the lines of its [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]. Although the factories were to be kept a secret from the Republic, they were nevertheless discovered by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], while on a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|retreat]] with Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] at [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Amidala secured a disk containing tactical coordinates for the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|main droid foundry]] and passed the information on to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], which looked to invade Geonosis to shut down the foundries. In order to divert the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] attention from striking at Geonosis, the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned an attack on the Republic-loyal planet [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. ==The battle== {{Quote|Yes, Commander, press the attack. I don't want any of that Kel Dor filth to survive. The people of the planet Dorin must suffer the consequences for staying loyal to the Republic.''"
"''Roger, roger. The commando droids will hunt down any survivors.|General Grievous and a battle droid commander|}} Commanding his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of his [[Grievous's Separatist frigate|frigate]], Grievous launched an assault on Dorin with a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of two [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]] and sixteen [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], deploying his battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] to lay waste to the civilian Kel Dor population. Although the Kel Dors valiantly fought back against the Separatists, they soon began to be overwhelmed due to the enemy support of Grievous's [[Confederate Navy/Legends|invasion fleet]]. During the fighting, Grievous ordered his [[Battle droid commander (Dorin)|battle droid commander]] to press the attack, seeking to make the Kel Dors pay the price for their allegiance to the Republic. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] replied that their [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] would hunt down any survivors of the initial assault. Presently, the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] received word of the invasion, and Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]—a Kel Dor himself—and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] along with the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]; and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] to lead a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] to reinforce Dorin. Skywalker in particular was selected for his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] expertise, which would be invaluable in leading the task force because of Dorin's orientation between two [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]]. [[File:CruisersAtDorin.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Republic fleet holds position against the Separatists over Dorin.]] Separatist intelligence received word of the Republic task force's departure from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] relayed the warning to Grievous. To prepare for Skywalker's arrival, Grievous recalled his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] from the surface and deployed his [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] for battle. Koon, Skywalker, Tano, Yularen, and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived at Dorin with their task force of nine [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], including the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and [[Unity (Venator-class)|''Unity'']], and [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] the Separatists in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above the planet. The Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] dispatched [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper]]–piloted [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], with one led by Skywalker and the Jedi Knight from their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptors]], and another unit under the command of Tano. Skywalker and Tano made sport of their respective squadrons' number of [[Death/Legends|kills]], seeing whose fighter group could tally up more hits. While the Jedi and their starfighter squadrons [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combated]] the Separatists' fighter patrols of [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], the Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] exchanged [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire with the Separatist [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] over Dorin. However, the latter [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] used their heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] to tear through the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], destroying the ''Unity'' in the process. With Yularen and the ''Resolute'' now subjected to enemy fire, Skywalker responded by having his squadron focus on the enemy frigate that was bearing down on the ''Resolute''. The battle soon turned in the Republic's favor as the Confederate forces began to be overwhelmed. When his fleet was forced into retreat from Dorin, Grievous departed from his flotilla in his [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]], and Skywalker and his Jedi Knight compatriot immediately left their squadron to give chase, while Plo Koon took their [[Clone trooper/Legends|men]] to target another enemy frigate. Despite the Jedi's efforts to stop him, Grievous was able to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], abandoning his remaining forces to be routed by the Kel Dors and the Republic. By the time the battle was over, the Jedi's squadrons had achieved a number of enemy kills, totaling at least 131 between Skywalker's and Tano's men. ==Aftermath== {{Dialogue|Kenobi|You're late.|Skywalker|Sorry, Master, Ahsoka and I were busy routing the Seppies near Dorin.|Tano|My squadron alone had fifty-five kills.|Skywalker|Yeah, but mine had seventy-six.|Tano|Show-off.|attr=Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano|audio=ShowOff-LaPR.flac|src=}} [[File:GeonosisPlanning.png|thumb|right|250px|Having arrived at Geonosis, Skywalker and Tano assist in planning the assault.]] With their victory at Dorin, Skywalker, Tano, Yularen, and the ''Resolute''{{TCWA|Geonosis Saga}}[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.20]] joined the large Republic invasion force at Geonosis, under the overall command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. Skywalker and Tano briefly recounted their enemy kills at Dorin by comparing them against those of each other, with Skywalker boasting his greater tally, seventy-six, to Tano's fifty-five. After completing a briefing with their [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]] and forming a plan of attack on the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] surface defenses, the Jedi launched their [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|massive invasion]] aimed at retaking Geonosis and shutting down its droid factories. Journals written by Jedi who had participated in the Battle of Dorin, as the conflict became known, were eventually published in a collection known as the [[Jedi Battle Logs]].{{TCWA|coll=Jedi Battle Logs Vol 2}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|At the recent ''Star Wars'' Fan Days III convention near Dallas, supervising director Dave Filoni reunited most of the cast of ''The Clone Wars'' for a table read of a script specially prepared for the event.|[[StarWars.com]], introducing the script featuring the Battle of Dorin|}} The Battle of Dorin was created by Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] for the [[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, serving as a lead-in to the episode "[[Landing at Point Rain]]." It was introduced at a script reading that was organized by Filoni and was performed by the television series' main voice-acting cast at the [[October]] 2009 ''Star Wars'' Fan Days III convention. The battle was first depicted in the "Starfighter" mini-game of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]], which also provided the "Battle of Dorin" name. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] {{1st}} {{1stID|Battle of Dorin}} *{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Battle of Dorin}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}} {{1stm}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}} *{{InsiderCite|118|Rise of the Bounty Hunters (article)}} *{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}} *{{FactFile2014|69|GRI 9-12|General Grievous}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Dorin (22 VSY) |es=Batalla de Dorin |esGA=1 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dorin, Battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Dorin]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]]
